policy.bos_context: four explicit out-of-vocabulary context sentinels per full chunk when extracting shorter start-of-chunk histories; sentinels are never targets
policy.chunk_formula: on zero-based document visit j, chunk_index=j mod n_d
policy.ngram_boundary_policy: reset at every selected full chunk and document; never form cross-chunk/document n-grams
policy.target_slice: chunk token ids [1:513], matching the 512 supervised target positions over W0/W1
